A sea chart that changes its road: one line style per sea

With 14 seas on one scrolling chart, the road between stages looked the same everywhere. We gave each sea its own line style, color and wiggle, made the angle continue across sea borders, and only draw what is on screen. The values, the tests, and what we have not seen on a phone.

A difficulty curve with a floor: no stage the simplest bot can never win

With hundreds of stages, a few hard ones are not a few hard ones, they are a wall. We retuned all 14 seas to a curve with a rest stage in every sea, capped how strong the enemy AI may be, and added a test that fails if the simplest bot wins 0 of 40. The before and after.
